title_en: Provisions on the Transfer of Suspected Criminal Cases by Administrative Law Enforcement Organs

articles.content_en: Article 1 These Provisions are formulated for the purposes of ensuring that administrative law enforcement organs timely transfer suspected criminal cases to public security organs, lawfully punishing crimes of undermining the socialist market economic order, crimes of obstructing the administration of social order, and other crimes, and safeguarding the smooth progress of socialist construction.

Article 2 For the purpose of these Provisions, "administrative law enforcement organs" refer to administrative organs that, in accordance with the provisions of laws, regulations, or rules, have the power to impose administrative penalties for acts of undermining the socialist market economic order, obstructing the administration of social order, and other illegal acts, as well as organizations authorized by laws or regulations to exercise public affairs management functions and to impose administrative penalties within the scope of statutory authorization.

Article 3 In the process of investigating and handling illegal acts according to law, if an administrative law enforcement organ discovers that the amount involved in the illegal facts, the circumstances of the illegal facts, the consequences caused by the illegal facts, etc., in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law regarding crimes of undermining the socialist market economic order and crimes of obstructing the administration of social order, and the judicial interpretations of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate regarding such crimes, as well as the prosecution standards for economic crime cases of the Supreme People's Procuratorate and the Ministry of Public Security, are suspected of constituting a crime and that criminal liability shall be investigated according to law, it must transfer the case to the public security organ in accordance with these Provisions.
For illegal cases in the field of intellectual property, if an administrative law enforcement organ, based on the evidence collected through investigation and the ascertained case facts, considers that there is a reasonable suspicion of a crime and that the public security organ needs to take measures to further obtain evidence to determine whether the case meets the filing and prosecution standards for a criminal case, it shall transfer the case to the public security organ.

Article 4 In the process of investigating and handling illegal acts, an administrative law enforcement organ must properly preserve the evidence collected in relation to the illegal acts.
An administrative law enforcement organ shall truthfully fill out a list of the seized articles involved in the case and handle them in accordance with the relevant provisions of the State. For articles involved in the case that are perishable, subject to deterioration, or otherwise unsuitable or difficult to preserve, it shall take necessary measures to retain evidence; for articles involved in the case that require inspection or expert evaluation, such inspection or expert evaluation shall be conducted by a statutory inspection or expert evaluation institution, which shall issue an inspection report or expert evaluation conclusion.

Article 5 For a suspected criminal case that shall be transferred to a public security organ, the administrative law enforcement organ shall immediately designate two or more administrative law enforcement personnel to form a special case team to take charge, verify the facts, and then submit a written report on the transfer of the suspected criminal case for approval by the principal responsible person or the responsible person in charge of the work of the organ.
The principal responsible person or the responsible person in charge of the work of the administrative law enforcement organ shall make a decision on whether to approve the transfer within three days from the date of receiving the report. If the decision is to approve, the transfer shall be made to the public security organ at the same level within 24 hours; if the decision is not to approve, the reasons for disapproval shall be recorded in the file.

Article 7 A public security organ shall sign the receipt of the letter of transfer for a suspected criminal case transferred by an administrative law enforcement organ; if the case is not within its jurisdiction, it shall, within 24 hours, transfer the case to the organ with jurisdiction and notify the administrative law enforcement organ that transferred the case in writing.

Article 8 A public security organ shall, within three days from the date of receiving a suspected criminal case transferred by an administrative law enforcement organ, review the transferred case in accordance with the Criminal Law, the Criminal Procedure Law, the provisions of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on case-filing standards, and the provisions of the Ministry of Public Security on procedures for handling criminal cases by public security organs. If it finds that a crime has occurred and criminal liability needs to be investigated, and decides to file the case according to law, it shall notify the transferring administrative law enforcement organ in writing; if it finds that no crime has occurred, or the crime is so minor that it does not warrant investigation of criminal liability, and decides not to file the case according to law, it shall state the reasons, notify the transferring administrative law enforcement organ in writing, and return the case materials accordingly.

Article 9 After receiving the notice of decision not to file a case from a public security organ, if an administrative law enforcement organ considers that the public security organ shall decide to file the case according to law, it may, within three days from the date of receiving the notice of decision not to file the case, request the public security organ that made the decision not to file the case to reconsider, or it may suggest that the People's Procuratorate carry out case-filing supervision according to law.
The public security organ that made the decision not to file the case shall, within three days from the date of receiving the request for reconsideration from the administrative law enforcement organ, make a decision to file or not to file the case and notify the transferring administrative law enforcement organ in writing. If the transferring administrative law enforcement organ still has objections to the reconsideration decision of the public security organ not to file the case, it shall, within three days from the date of receiving the notice of reconsideration decision, suggest that the People's Procuratorate carry out case-filing supervision according to law.
The public security organ shall accept the case-filing supervision carried out by the People's Procuratorate according to law.

Article 10 An administrative law enforcement organ shall handle according to law a case for which the public security organ decides not to file the case; among such cases, if an administrative penalty shall be imposed in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws, regulations, or rules, the administrative penalty shall be imposed according to law.

Article 11 An administrative law enforcement organ shall not replace the transfer of a suspected criminal case that shall be transferred to a public security organ with an administrative penalty.
If, before transferring a suspected criminal case to a public security organ, an administrative law enforcement organ has already made an administrative penalty decision of warning, ordering cessation of production or business, suspending or revoking a permit, or suspending or revoking a license, such decision shall not cease to be enforced.
In accordance with the provisions of the Administrative Penalty Law, if, before transferring a suspected criminal case to a public security organ, an administrative law enforcement organ has already imposed a fine on a party according to law, when the People's Court imposes a criminal fine, it shall be offset against the corresponding fine according to law.

Article 12 For a case for which the public security organ decides to file a case, the administrative law enforcement organ shall, within three days from the date of receiving the notice of case-filing, transfer the articles involved in the case and other materials related to the case to the public security organ and complete the handover procedures; if there are other provisions in laws or administrative regulations, those provisions shall prevail.

Article 13 If, upon review, a public security organ finds that a discovered illegal act does not involve a crime, or after filing and investigating the case, it considers that the criminal facts are so minor that it does not require investigation of criminal liability, but administrative liability shall be investigated according to law, it shall promptly transfer the case to the administrative law enforcement organ at the same level, and the relevant administrative law enforcement organ shall handle the case according to law.

Article 14 The transfer of suspected criminal cases by administrative law enforcement organs shall be subject to the supervision carried out by the People's Procuratorate and the supervisory organs according to law.
Any unit or individual that discovers that an administrative law enforcement organ, in violation of these Provisions, fails to transfer a suspected criminal case that shall be transferred to a public security organ, has the right to report the matter to the People's Procuratorate, the supervisory organ, or the superior administrative law enforcement organ.

Article 15 If an administrative law enforcement organ, in violation of these Provisions, conceals, privately distributes, or destroys articles involved in the case, the people's government at the same level or at the next higher level, or the superior administrative law enforcement organ under vertical management, shall impose a sanction of demotion or above on its principal responsible person according to the seriousness of the circumstances; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.
The directly responsible managers and other directly liable persons for the acts listed in the preceding paragraph shall be sanctioned by reference to the provisions of the preceding paragraph; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 16 If an administrative law enforcement organ, in violation of these Provisions, fails to transfer a case to a public security organ within the time limit, the people's government at the same level or at the next higher level, or the superior administrative law enforcement organ under vertical management, shall order it to transfer the case within a specified period and shall impose a sanction of demerit record or above on its principal responsible person or the responsible person in charge of the work according to the seriousness of the circumstances; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.
If an administrative law enforcement organ, in violation of these Provisions, fails to transfer a case that shall be transferred to a public security organ, or replaces the transfer with an administrative penalty, the people's government at the same level or at the next higher level, or the superior administrative law enforcement organ under vertical management, shall order it to rectify and circulate a notice of criticism; if it refuses to rectify, a sanction of demerit record or above shall be imposed on its principal responsible person or the responsible person in charge of the work; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.
The directly responsible managers and other directly liable persons for the acts listed in the first and second paragraphs of this Article shall be sanctioned respectively by reference to the provisions of the preceding two paragraphs; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 17 If a public security organ, in violation of these Provisions, fails to accept a suspected criminal case transferred by an administrative law enforcement organ, or fails to make a decision on filing or not filing the case within the time limit, in addition to the People's Procuratorate carrying out case-filing supervision according to law, the people's government at the same level or at the next higher level shall order it to rectify and shall impose a sanction of demerit record or above on its principal responsible person according to the seriousness of the circumstances; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.
The directly responsible managers and other directly liable persons for the acts listed in the preceding paragraph shall be sanctioned by reference to the provisions of the preceding paragraph; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 18 If a relevant organ commits the illegal acts listed in Articles 15, 16, and 17 of these Provisions and it is necessary for the supervisory organ to impose a disciplinary sanction on the illegal public officials according to law, the organ and its superior competent authority or the relevant people's government shall transfer the relevant case leads to the supervisory organ for handling in accordance with the relevant provisions.

Article 19 In the process of investigating and handling illegal acts according to law, if an administrative law enforcement organ discovers that a public official has committed illegal acts such as embezzlement, bribery, dereliction of duty, abuse of power to infringe upon citizens' personal rights and democratic rights, which are suspected of constituting duty-related crimes, it shall, in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law, the Criminal Procedure Law, the Supervision Law, and other laws, promptly transfer the case leads to the supervisory organ or the People's Procuratorate for handling.
Article 20 These Provisions shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
